harry_mkt: Quick question 0 Forrester asked if we can provide a short embargoed one-pager with the benchmark methodology. They need it for their internal review. Can product & legal sign off on a 1-page methodology summary?
sasha_pr: Would prefer a 1-page that focuses on inputs and measurement methodology, no internal tooling details. Nina, can you craft?
nina_prod: I can draft. Key bullets: workload profile, dataset sampling, runs per config, environment, baseline model version. Will avoid internal infra specifics.
kevin_legal: Legal: keep it high-level. No mention of named customers or cloud provider billing specifics. Add the "internal results may vary" note.
harry_mkt: Great. Also, Forrester requested two short quotes from product & CEO. PR to provide and we need those by EOD tomorrow.
sasha_pr: Noted. I'll draft CEO quote + product soundbite. Nina, could you add a short technical line suitable for analysts (1-2 sentences) saying why this matters for product teams?
nina_prod: Drafting now, will place in the doc.
press_bot: Reminder set: methodology one-pager due 2026-05-10 17:00 PT.
